rules.title: Treat model output as untrusted
rules.text: Treat model output as untrusted input: validate and sanitize it before rendering, executing or storing.

rules.title: Defend against prompt injection
rules.text: Keep untrusted content separate from instructions and never give a model with untrusted input access to secrets or destructive tools.

rules.title: Structured outputs
rules.text: Request structured output with a schema and validate it, with a repair or retry path.

rules.title: Evals for prompts
rules.text: Keep an evaluation set and run it before changing prompts or models.

rules.title: Prompts as code
rules.text: Store prompts in version control as templates, not as strings scattered through the code.

rules.title: Track cost and latency
rules.text: Log token usage, latency and cost per request and set budgets and timeouts.

rules.title: Handle failures
rules.text: Handle rate limits, timeouts and refusals with retries, backoff and a graceful fallback.

rules.title: Configurable models
rules.text: Make model names and parameters configuration, not hardcoded constants.

rules.title: Minimize data sent
rules.text: Send the minimum data to external model providers and redact personal data first.

rules.title: Stream long responses
rules.text: Stream long responses to the UI and handle partial output and cancellation.
